policy: Course coordinates are independently digitized from licensed georeferenced aerial imagery. Pinned raster and source hashes reproduce each draft centerline. Timing GPS remains private.

records.evidence: The full paved circuit follows the main straight, northern hairpin, upper switchback and southern wooded technical section visible in the independent 2019 aerial image. Pit-entry and paddock driveways are excluded. The operator identifies one full circuit with 18 turns; its advertised 2.2-mile length is approximate and is not used to scale the geometry.

The association lists Kinsmen Kart Club at Dixon. The independently visible paved full circuit retains the northeastern bulb, central hairpin and two western hairpins. The small diagonal infield connector, pit access and neighboring dirt speedway are excluded. Fine corner alignment and driving direction remain draft.

The operator's Kart #1 course uses both west and east kart loops: Long Beach, The Glen, Zolder, Daytona, Imola, Monza, the Mulsanne Straight and Monte Carlo triangular return via Spa. The independently visible paved centerline retains those branches and excludes the oval shortcut, hot pits and surrounding main road circuit. Operator route dimensions identify a full course of roughly 952 m; mapping is not scaled to that distance.

The narrow two-straight test loop east of the TRC Ohio high-speed oval is independently digitized from public-domain 2023 aerial imagery. The operator identifies the Ohio proving-ground site and its testing facilities; the catalogue name and timing location identify this specific loop. The small southern turnaround and northern crossing return are retained; the large high-speed oval and adjacent handling roads are excluded. Turnaround alignment and direction remain draft.

records.referenceId: United States/Thermal Club Twin Palms Short
records.evidence: Twin Palms Short retains the middle Desert course with its northern undulations and eastern roundabout return, joined to the South Palm outer course. It excludes the North Palm extension, the South Palm inner technical loop, karting roads and pit access. Independently read public-domain 2022 NAIP pavement centers identify the full short branch sequence; route distance is unscaled and historical barriers and direction remain draft. The 2022 aerial centerline differs from the 3999 m catalogue scalar; the geometry is not scaled to match it.

The operator’s Rallycross configuration retains the northern and western gravel arc, the long central asphalt hairpin and the southern outer gravel return. The inner karting loops, the asphalt-only outer course and pit lane are excluded. The route is manually digitized on the independently georeferenced GUGiK orthoimage. Surface transitions, temporary barriers, fine corner alignment and historical configuration remain provisional. No diagram coordinates or comparison-course GPS are used.

The operator identifies the Autodrom Jastrzab training and motorsport complex. This configuration uses both Northern hairpins, the long Western return and its small infield hairpin, the central triangular-island return and Eastern S bends. The Southern connection crosses the paved training apron and bypasses the separate Southern skid circle. The route is independently digitized from freely reusable GUGiK government orthoimagery because the public map omits the Northern return and several source ways contain angular shortcuts. All pixel anchors are picked on visible pavement in the government raster; neither catalogue picture vertices nor timing GPS set course coordinates. The independently measured 1741.0 m versus the catalogue 1715 m is retained, with a 45 m allowance for provisional centerline and historical temporary-cone alignment. Direction, temporary barriers and corner alignment remain draft.

The operator identifies Track 3 as the wet handling course with a 0.45-mile short configuration. This catalogue branch retains the Northern turn-in, middle S, rounded Southern return and Eastern hairpin of that short wet loop. The surrounding dry handling road and outer wet-loop extension are excluded. The centerline is manually digitized only on visible pavement in pinned public-domain 2023 USGS/USDA NAIP imagery. The independent 663.6 m measured route remains unscaled against the 698 m catalogue scalar and the approximate advertised 0.45-mile length; a 45 m catalogue allowance retains historical corner and surface-path differences as a draft limitation. No catalogue image vertices or timing positions determine these coordinates.
